question: settings
answer:
`nvidia_ai.config.Settings` has three direct consumers:

- The package CLI calls `Settings.from_env()` on the default command path. It uses `log_level` to configure logging and `env` in the startup message. [src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/__main__.py:19)
- The benchmark CLI uses the NVIDIA base URL and API key and the Ollama base URL to configure provider endpoints. It requires the key when NVIDIA is selected and also uses the Ollama URL to fetch version and model digest metadata. [src/nvidia_ai/bench.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/src/nvidia_ai/bench.py:379)
- The smoke test clears the relevant environment variables and disables `.env` loading to verify the defaults `dev`, `INFO`, and `Path("data")`. [tests/test_smoke.py](<work>/anvil-rules-official-codex/tests/test_smoke.py:12)
